rows.text_en: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family ( Multicultural Family Division ), 02-2100-6372

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「다문화가족지원법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Multicultural Family Support Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다문화가족 실태조사의 대상 및 방법 등) ① 성평등가족부장관은 「다문화가족지원법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제4조에 따라 결혼이민자등과 그 한국인 배우자 및 자녀 등을 대상으로 하는 다문화가족 실태조사(이하 “실태조사”라 한다)를 실시한다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Subjects and Methods, etc. of the Survey on the Status of Multicultural Families) ① The Minister for Gender Equality and Family(hereinafter referred to as the “Survey on Status” ) targeting marriage immigrants, etc., and their Korean spouses and children, etc., pursuant to Article 4 of the Multicultural Family Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”). <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 성평등가족부장관은 제1항에 따른 실태조사를 다문화가족에 관한 전문성, 인력 및 장비를 갖춘 연구기관ㆍ법인 또는 단체에 의뢰하여 실시할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Gender Equality and Family may commission the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 to a research institution, corporation, or organization equipped with expertise, personnel, and equipment regarding multicultural families. <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 실태조사에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 shall include the following matters. <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 성별, 연령, 학력, 취업상태 등 가족구성원의 일반특성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the general characteristics of family members, such as gender, age, educational background, and employment status

rows.source_ko: 2. 소득, 지출, 자산 등 가족의 경제상태에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the family's economic status, such as income, expenses, and assets

rows.source_ko: 3. 자녀양육, 가족부양 등 가족행태 및 가족관계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning family behavior and family relations, such as child rearing and family support

rows.source_ko: 4. 의식주, 소비, 여가, 정보 이용 등 생활양식에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning lifestyle, such as food, clothing, shelter, consumption, leisure, and use of information
5. Matters concerning family issues, such as family conflicts

rows.source_ko: 6. 다문화가족 지원 관련 교육ㆍ상담 등 서비스 수요에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the demand for services, such as education and counseling, related to support for multicultural families

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 다문화가족의 현황 및 실태파악에 필요한 사항으로서 성평등가족부장관이 정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters necessary for understanding the current status and conditions of multicultural families as determined by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: ④ 성평등가족부장관은 사회환경의 급격한 변동 등으로 추가적인 조사가 필요할 때에는 제1항에 따른 실태조사 외에 임시조사를 실시하여 이를 보완할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ When additional investigation is necessary due to rapid changes in the social environment or the like, the Minister of Gender Equality and Family may supplement the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 by conducting a provisional investigation. <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(다문화가족 종합정보 전화센터의 설치ㆍ운영기준) 법 제11조의2제4항에 따른 다문화가족 종합정보 전화센터(이하 “전화센터”라 한다)의 설치ㆍ운영기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Standards for Installation and Operation of Multicultural Family Comprehensive Information Telephone Center) The standards for installation and operation of the Multicultural Family Comprehensive Information Telephone Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Telephone Center”) pursuant to Article 11-2, Paragraph 4 of the Actare as set forth in the attached table .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 30, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다문화가족지원센터 전문인력의 기준) 법 제12조제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따른 다문화가족지원센터(이하 “지원센터”라 한다)에는 같은 조 제5항에 따라 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 전문인력을 1명 이상 두어야 한다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2012. 8. 16., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Standards for Professional Staff at Multicultural Family Support Centers) A Multicultural Family Support Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Support Center”) pursuant to Article 12, Paragraphs 1 through 3 of the Act shall employ at least one professional staff member falling under any of the following subparagraphs in accordance with Paragraph 5 of the same Article . <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Aug. 16, 2012; Oct. 1, 2025>
1. Healthy Family Counselor pursuant to Article 35 of the Framework Act on Healthy Families
2. Social worker pursuant to Article 11 of the Social Welfare Services Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 성평등가족부장관이 인정하는 관련 분야의 전문인력
rows.text_en: 3. Other professional personnel in related fields recognized by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: 제4조(위탁계약서) 「다문화가족지원법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제12조의2제2항에 따른 위탁계약에는 다음 각 호의 내용이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Consignment Contract) A consignment contract pursuant to Article 12-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Multicultural Family Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)shall include the contents of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
1. Name and address of the trustee
2. Consignment Contract Period
3. Facilities Subject to Entrustment and Details of Work
4. Duties and Compliance Requirements of the Trustee
5. Matters concerning the safety management of the Support Center
6. Matters concerning the succession of employment of specialized personnel
7. Matters concerning the termination of the contract

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 성평등가족부장관이 지원센터의 운영에 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family for the operation of the Support Center
[Wholly Amended Aug. 16, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(다문화가족지원센터 지정 신청서) 영 제12조의3제1항에 따른 다문화가족지원센터 지정 신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Application for Designation of Multicultural Family Support Center) The application for designation of a multicultural family support center pursuant to Article 12-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 1 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 16, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(다문화가족지원센터 지정서) 영 제12조의3제3항에 따른 다문화가족지원센터 지정서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Designation Certificate for Multicultural Family Support Center) The designation certificate for a multicultural family support center pursuant to Article 12-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as shown in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 16, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(전문인력 양성기관 지정 신청서) 영 제12조의4제1항에 따른 다문화가족지원 전문인력 양성기관 지정 신청서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Designation of Professional Training Institution) The application for designation of a professional training institution for multicultural family support pursuant to Article 12-4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decreeis as per Form No. 3 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 16, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(전문인력 양성기관 지정서) 영 제12조의4제3항에 따른 다문화가족지원 전문인력 양성기관 지정서는 별지 제4호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Designation Certificate for Professional Training Institutions) The designation certificate for professional training institutions for multicultural family support pursuant to Article 12-4, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as shown in Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 16, 2012]
Article 9 (Standards for Implementation of Continuing Education) ① Deleted <December 12, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ② 보수교육은 집합교육, 온라인 교육 등 다양한 방법으로 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Continuing education may be conducted through various methods, such as group training and online training.

rows.source_ko: ③ 보수교육에는 다문화사회의 이해, 다문화가족정책, 비영리기관의 운영관리 등이 포함되도록 하고, 그 구체적인 내용은 성평등가족부장관이 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Continuing education shall include the understanding of multicultural society, multicultural family policies, and the operation and management of non-profit organizations, and the specific details thereof shall be determined by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 16, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(규제의 재검토) 성평등가족부장관은 다음 각 호의 사항에 대하여 2015년 1월 1일을 기준으로 2년마다(매 2년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall review the validity of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs every two years, starting from January 1, 2015 (meaning until the day before the same date as the reference date of every second year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제2조의2 및 별표에 따른 다문화가족 종합정보 전화센터의 설치ㆍ운영기준
rows.text_en: 1. Standards for the establishment and operation of the Multicultural Family Comprehensive Information Telephone Center pursuant to Article 2-2 and the Annex
2. Deleted <April 2, 2021>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 12, 2014]
